Docket 1.3.106

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $349, or 4 payments of $87.25, to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *Topic suggestions no longer fetch answers they throw away.* When you do not give a
  topic, Docket reads what your site is about and asks Google's public autocomplete
  what people type around it. It asked 31 questions per topic, 18 of them commercial
  variants ("price", "near me", "template") whose answers it then deleted. It now
  asks only the 13 it keeps. On one real site that was 62 requests and 32 seconds
  down to 26 requests and 13 seconds, with the same 112 suggestions; on a second pair
  of topics the same 212 came back both ways. The
  `docket attack` command still asks the commercial ones.
- *The outbound link check covers more places.* It checked the first 60 links it met,
  so a button repeated on every page could fill half the check with one destination.
  It now checks at most 8 links to any one site, so the same 60 checks reach more
  places and finish sooner. The finding and the report say the links are sampled,
  at most 8 per site, not every link.

99 checks across 13 areas.
